edition.notes: Migne reprints Coustant for the Siricius letters, retaining Coustant's apparatus on authenticity, manuscript variants, and the disputed question whether Western continence law begins with this decretal. The Internet Archive scan of this volume duplicates several leaves; navigation is by column number.
edition.title: Patrologia Latina tomus XIII

passages.context: Siricius, Epistola I ad Himerium, cap. VII n. 10: 'Quarum sanctionum omnes sacerdotes atque levitae insolubili lege constringimur, ut a die ordinationis nostrae, sobrietati ac pudicitiae et corda nostra mancipemus et corpora, dummodo per omnia Deo nostro in his, quae quotidie offerimus, sacrificiis placeamus.'
passages.notes: Read visually at the page images of leaves 587 and 590. The letter's conventional date of 10 February 385 was not verified because the subscription page was not read.
